assumptions.concept: Ground-floor commercial with two residential levels above.
assumptions.screening_note: Indicative design assumptions only, not Planning Atlas controls: 180 sqm footprint on at least 300 sqm targets no more than 60% site coverage; 14m frontage, 24m depth and approximately 11m total height are concept inputs. Connected data does not establish land-use permission, authoritative height, frontage, coverage, setbacks, parking, access, overlays or mixed-use interface requirements. Planner review is required.
